name: 3D Flip In
description: Letters stand up from their baselines in perspective, a soft staggered wave; they tip back over the top on exit.
move: Letters stand up from their baselines in perspective, a soft staggered wave; they tip back over the top on exit.
how: Characters get transformPerspective 700 and a bottom-centre origin; rotationX -95→0 and yPercent 18→0 over 1.15s, stagger 0.03, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); opacity 0.4s. Exit switches the origin to top-centre and rotates to +95 with power2.in. An accent span keeps its colour per word.
adapt: Mark the accent words with a [data-accent] span in the title. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "3D Flip In Rotate X" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
